title: One-sided randomized time-bounded decision
statement:
Let $N$ be a finite-state nondeterministic Turing machine over the Boolean alphabet, let $L$ be a language of Boolean strings, let $T: bn	o bn$ be a time bound, and let $p: bn	o bq$. For every input string $x$, the machine halts within $T(|x|)$ steps; if $x
otin L$, every choice string of length exactly $T(|x|)$ makes its output the one-symbol string consisting of false; and if $x\in L$, the probability that its output is the one-symbol string consisting of true after $T(|x|)$ steps is at least $p(|x|)$.
